verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents segments defined as groups of users matching trait-based rules (location, plan, app version, usage), with flag overrides for every user in a segment. It also supports multivariate variants and percentage rollouts within a segment, and segments can be managed through the Admin API and CLI. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of rule operators and AND/OR logic, explicit evidence that one segment is reused across multiple flags, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can target flags with attribute-based rules and reusable segments so the right users see the right variation

citations.quote: Define segments—groups of users matching rules based on traits (e.g., location, plan, app version, usage). Override feature flags for all users in a segment.
Target features to users with specific traits (such as geography, subscription level, device type, or application version).
Multivariate flags let you define multiple variants with percentage weightings (A/B/n).
Gradually enable a feature for a percentage of users, either globally or within a segment.
Use segments to run A/B and multivariate tests on new features
The Flagsmith CLI lets you manage flags, segments, features, projects and environments from your terminal
